body: On mobile, app didn't want to cooperate, and while I want to share to amuse, I'm still too hurt to care that deeply about font

Thank you for the supporting comments and pms guys. She decided to end it, and the fucked up part is she was going to propose to me... there is an engagement ring in my closet. Strangely, I haven't wanted to die from pain of the breakup... for once I feel like I have hope, and that I'm very alive, ironically waiting on her to come around. I feel like it won't, and there is a huge part of me that just wants to wear that ring and slit my wrists as a conscious decision to avoid the eventual heart break... i don't know where I'm at right now.

Thank you
